answer: Make standing perishable: an identity's trust is a timber beam that rots unless renewed by fresh verified work each epoch, with a random peer audit at every vertex where work changes hands. Any gap or failed audit turns the ember of suspicion into a full burn - bond slashed, standing reset to zero. A Sybil farm must keep every fake continuously doing real, audited work forever, so holding a hundred fakes costs a hundred honest workloads, not a one-time trick.
